sub_theme: People Who Help Us: Emergency Services

lessons.title: Recap: The Three Emergency Services
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name the police, fire service, and ambulance and their main role.
lessons.main_activity: Deepen discussion of each service's role using pictures/vehicles, focusing on uniforms and equipment.
key_questions: What does a firefighter wear and why?
What tools does a paramedic use?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note recall and deepened understanding — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap all three emergency services.
lessons.home_link: Talk about emergency service vehicles you've seen.

lessons.title: Listening for Emergency Vehicle Sounds
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify which emergency vehicle makes a given siren sound.
lessons.main_activity: Children listen to and match siren sounds to the correct emergency vehicle picture.
resources_needed: Siren sound recordings, vehicle picture cards
lessons.assessment_notes: Note auditory discrimination — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of siren sounds identified.
lessons.home_link: Listen for emergency vehicle sounds on a walk together.

lessons.title: Story Time: A Fire Engine Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sequence the main events of the story.
lessons.main_activity: Read a fire-service themed story, then sequence 3-4 picture cards of key events.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note sequencing comprehension — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Retell the story as a class using the sequenced cards.
lessons.home_link: Retell today's story to someone at home.

lessons.title: Counting Emergency Vehicle Wheels/Lights
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count features on vehicles accurately.
lessons.starter_activity: Count wheels on a toy vehicle together.
lessons.main_activity: Children count wheels, lights, or windows on emergency vehicle pictures, recording totals.
key_questions: How many wheels does this vehicle have?
Can you count them again to check?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record counting accuracy — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class total count recap.
lessons.home_link: Count wheels on vehicles you see today.

lessons.title: How Do We Call for Help?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain when and how to call 999.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss in more depth when it's appropriate to call 999 (real emergencies only) versus other situations, with scenario sorting.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of appropriate emergency response — evidence for UTW.2/PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap when to call 999.
lessons.home_link: Learn your home address with an adult in case of emergency.

lessons.title: Explaining an Emergency Scenario
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe a simple emergency scenario using full sentences.
lessons.starter_activity: Adult models describing a simple scenario.
lessons.main_activity: Using picture prompts, children describe what is happening in an emergency scenario picture and who might help.
key_questions: What is happening in this picture?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note descriptive/explanatory language — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Share scenario descriptions with the group.
lessons.home_link: Talk about what to do if you see someone needs help.

lessons.title: Phonics: Introducing 'qu'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say the sound 'qu' and blend words (quiz, quit).
lessons.main_activity: Introduce 'qu' sound/action; blend new words.
key_questions: What sound do these letters make?
lessons.assessment_notes: Update phonics tracker for 'qu'.
lessons.plenary: Practise all digraphs plus 'qu'.
lessons.home_link: Practise blending quiz, quit.

lessons.title: Positional Language: Vehicle Parking
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to use positional language to park toy vehicles correctly.
lessons.main_activity: Using a floor mat with parking bays, children follow instructions to park toy emergency vehicles using positional language.
resources_needed: Floor mat/parking bay template, toy vehicles
key_questions: Where is the fire engine parked?
Can you park the ambulance behind it?

differentiation.extension: Use 4+ positional words including between/next to

lessons.assessment_notes: Note range of positional vocabulary used accurately — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Quick positional language quiz.
lessons.home_link: Practise positional language with toy cars at home.

lessons.title: A Day in the Life of a Paramedic
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe what a paramedic's job involves.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the doctor/nurse role-play from Week 6.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss a paramedic's job (attending emergencies, giving first aid, taking people to hospital) using pictures/props.

differentiation.extension: Explain the sequence of a paramedic's response

lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of healthcare helper roles — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap paramedic role.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a time an ambulance helped your family or community.

lessons.title: Following Instructions: First Aid Basics
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to follow simple first-aid related instructions (e.g. 'sit still', 'tell an adult').
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what to do if a friend gets a small bump.
lessons.main_activity: Practise following simple first-aid instructions in a role-play scenario (sit down, stay calm, tell an adult).
key_questions: What should you do first if someone is hurt?

differentiation.support: Adult models the instruction, child repeats
differentiation.extension: Recall the sequence of steps independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Note instruction-following and safety understanding — evidence for CL.1/PSED.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap basic first-aid steps.
lessons.home_link: Talk about what to do if someone gets hurt at home.

lessons.title: Writing Emergency Service Labels
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to attempt to write a simple label for an emergency service.
lessons.main_activity: Children draw an emergency vehicle and attempt to write its service name using known phonics sounds.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note writing progress — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Share labelled pictures with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Draw and label an emergency vehicle together at home.

lessons.title: Number Recognition: Emergency Numbers Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recognise numerals to 10 confidently, with focus on 9.
lessons.main_activity: Numeral matching game focusing on quick recognition, with a special focus on the number 9 and its importance (999).
lessons.assessment_notes: Record numeral recognition progress — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of the emergency number.
lessons.home_link: Practise recognising numbers on a phone/clock at home.

lessons.title: Coastguard and Mountain Rescue
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name an additional emergency helper role beyond the main three.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss who might help if someone is stuck at sea or on a mountain.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce coastguard and mountain rescue roles with pictures, discussing when they might be needed.
key_questions: Who helps people stuck on a mountain?

differentiation.extension: Discuss both roles and their equipment

lessons.assessment_notes: Note broadened understanding of emergency helper roles — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap all emergency helper roles learned across the two weeks.
lessons.home_link: Talk about other helpers you know about in your community.

lessons.title: Interviewing an Emergency Helper (Role-Play)
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to ask a simple question in a role-play interview.
lessons.main_activity: In pairs, one child role-plays an emergency helper while the other asks a prepared question, then swap roles.
key_questions: What did you ask the helper?

differentiation.support: Adult provides the question to ask
differentiation.extension: Child thinks of their own follow-up question

lessons.assessment_notes: Note question-asking and role-play language — evidence for CL.2/EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Class shares interesting interview answers.
lessons.home_link: Interview a family member about their job with one question.

lessons.title: Comparing Emergency Service Stories
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify a similarity between two emergency-service themed stories.
lessons.main_activity: Read a second emergency-service themed story and compare it to Monday's, noting similarities in how helpers assist others.
key_questions: What is similar about these stories?
How do the helpers assist others in each?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comparative comprehension — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of similarities found.
lessons.home_link: Compare two stories you know at home.

lessons.title: Sorting Emergency Vehicles by Colour
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sort vehicles by colour and count each group.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the colours of different emergency vehicles.
lessons.main_activity: Children sort a mixed set of vehicle picture cards by colour (red, white/yellow, green), counting each group.
key_questions: How many red vehicles did you find?

differentiation.extension: Sort into 3+ groups and compare totals

lessons.assessment_notes: Note sorting and counting skill — evidence for MATHS.2/MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class tally of all colour groups.
lessons.home_link: Sort toy vehicles by colour at home.

lessons.title: Emergency Services Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise the range of emergency helpers learned about across two weeks.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all emergency helper roles covered.
lessons.main_activity: Contribute to a large class display mapping all emergency helpers learned about and their roles.
key_questions: Which helper did you find most interesting?
What have we learned about emergency helpers?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the learning — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Unveil and admire the finished display.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about emergency helpers with your family.

lessons.title: Emergency Services Quiz Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer recall questions about emergency services learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Quiz-style game asking questions about emergency services, sirens, and helper roles from the week.
key_questions: Who do we call if there's a fire?
What number do we call in an emergency?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess recall and listening comprehension — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.plenary: Team points tally, celebrate together.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on emergency services learned this week.

lessons.title: Phonics Review: Digraphs Plus 'qu'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read words using all digraphs and 'qu' learned so far.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations: word-building, reading cards, simple sentence reading (e.g. 'the king can quiz').
key_questions: Can you build and read this word?
lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise week 21 phonics tracker.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate all sounds learned with a reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading simple sentences over the weekend.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Counting, Position, Sorting
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply counting, positional language, and sorting skills learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Rotate through 3 stations: counting vehicle features, positional parking game, sorting vehicles by colour.
key_questions: Which group does this belong to?
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 21 maths observations.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising sorting and counting over the weekend.
